description: This file defines a Java interface for reading report mailing job run history data within the Fineract platform. It specifies a method to retrieve paginated run history data filtered by job ID, using search parameters.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobRunHistoryReadPlatformService
classes.description: A service interface for accessing report mailing job run history data, providing methods to retrieve run histories based on job ID and search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveRunHistoryByJobId
methods.description: Retrieves a page of report mailing job run history data filtered by the specified report mailing job ID and search parameters.
